Interface ExpressionNode

All Known Implementing Classes:
ExpressionNode.Const, ExpressionNode.Empty, ExpressionNode.Operator, ExpressionNode.Param, ExpressionNode.Ref
public sealed interface ExpressionNode permits ExpressionNode.Operator, ExpressionNode.Ref, ExpressionNode.Const, ExpressionNode.Param, ExpressionNode.Empty
A node in an expression tree, as stored on an expression variable card. Nodes are immutable.
